death.note: Died 14 August 1961 at Sobolevo in deep old age; the Sretensky day prints «Прп. Александра исповедника (1961)» and the azbyka life gives the place.

birth.note: Born 1882 at Nevezhkino in the Chembar district of Penza province, azbyka.ru.

feast.note: His repose, and the day the Sretensky calendar prints «Прп. Александра исповедника (1961)». The corpus held the repose and the finding of the relics as two folders; the author ruled on 3 October 2026 that they are one man (TODO item 13 row 12), which is the nectarios/nektarios shape of row 1. It is not a doubt: both folders carry the one life, George Andreevich Urodov of Nevezhkino, born 1882, igumen of Sanaksar from 1915, deposed in 1918, archimandrite of the Semiozernaya hermitage, three years in the camps from 1928, twenty-six years at Sobolevo, dead 14 August 1961.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 августа ст. ст. — «Прп. Александра исповедника (1961)»

feast.note: The finding of his relics in 2001, as the Russian calendar keeps it — «Обретение мощей прп. Александра исп (2001)». His relics rest at Sanaksar. The azbyka life adds that he is kept also on 27 August and in the synaxes of the new martyrs of Solovki and of the Kazan and Vyatka saints; neither of those is a row here, because neither day has been read. The corpus held the repose and the finding of the relics as two folders; the author ruled on 3 October 2026 that they are one man (TODO item 13 row 12), which is the nectarios/nektarios shape of row 1. It is not a doubt: both folders carry the one life, George Andreevich Urodov of Nevezhkino, born 1882, igumen of Sanaksar from 1915, deposed in 1918, archimandrite of the Semiozernaya hermitage, three years in the camps from 1928, twenty-six years at Sobolevo, dead 14 August 1961.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 сентября ст. ст. — «Обретение мощей прп. Александра исп (2001)»
